overview: The School Committee celebrated numerous student achievements and district retirements, approved the 2026-2027 district calendar, and established a special education reserve fund.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The School Committee voted to enter executive session to discuss collective bargaining with teachers and teamsters as well as non-union contract negotiations.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The School Committee approved the consent agenda, including bills, payrolls, a donation to the McGlynn Library, and meeting minutes from May 18, 2026.

items.title: Mustang Moments and CPAC Retirements
items.summary: The School Committee celebrated various student achievements in art, esports, and the humanities, and recognized retiring Special Education Parent Advisory Council (CPAC) executive board members.

items.title: Staff Retirements and Employee Anniversaries
items.summary: The Committee recognized retiring public school employees and staff members marking 25, 30, and 40 years of service.

items.title: Marie Cassidy Retirement and Tufts University Donation
items.summary: The Committee honored retiring Medford Family Network founder Marie Cassidy and approved a $50,000 donation from Tufts University to the network.

items.title: 2026-2027 District Calendar
items.summary: The School Committee approved the amended 2026-2027 district school calendar, which includes swapping a professional development day to accommodate Good Friday.

items.title: Medford Public Schools Handbook Updates
items.summary: The Committee discussed updates to policies regarding elementary recess, student attendance, academic dishonesty, and busing, ultimately tabling the item until the next meeting to incorporate suggested edits.

items.title: Resolution 2026-12: Student Travel Policy JJH Update
items.summary: The Committee approved the first reading of an amendment to the student travel policy to streamline approvals for out-of-state competitions.

items.title: Resolution 2026-13: Special Education Reserve Fund
items.summary: The Committee approved a resolution to establish a special education reserve fund to help the district manage fluctuating and unanticipated special education expenses.
